notes.title: Update 20250520 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
1. Further improved melee system so that it's easier to land hits
2. Updated damage text pop-ups to indicate whether it's the player or the opponent being hit (different color schemes)
3. Reworked Boost powerup
4. Updated large buildings for The Silo and The Lair arenas
5. Increased duration of powerups to 10 seconds
6. Updated Tusk movement attributes (now jumps higher and runs slightly faster)
7. Updated Empower powerup so that melee attacks receive benefit as well
8. Updated graphics presets to enable smoother play on lower powered hardware
9. Introducing 'The Camp', a small arena in the Wasteland. Work in Progress.

Long list of bugs and other refinements we're working on and hope to include over the coming weeks.

notes.title: Update 20250510 - May Update and NextFest Preview
notes.notes:
1. Added new Pickup System:
- Empower (3x ranged damage, large arenas only)
- Invincibility (Large arenas only)
- Cloak (same as normal cloak ability, all arenas)
- Repair (+10pts health, all arenas)
- Recharge (+10pts energy, large arenas only)
2. Renamed LOADOUT menu to BUILD
3. Overhauled TUSK robot, added wireframe thumbnail to BUILD menu
4. Fixed issue with abilities not displaying correctly in LOBBY/BUILD menus
5. Updated BUILD menu to accurately show selected robot name
6. Refined movement speeds for all robots (MOTH: 500, HOPPER: 400, TUSK: 300)
7. Refined melee attacks for all robots, should be easier to land a hit now
8. Added targeting outline when robots are within melee range, also should make it easier to land a hit
9. Renamed medium sized arena to "The Silo"
10. Adjusted arena obstacles for all arenas
11. Added full screen hit indicator effect
12. Fixed issue with Pellet ability taking an extra second to fire after ability has been triggered
13. Rocket/Mortar attacks now cause AOE (area of effect) damage and knockback
14. Robots now begin to spark when they're below 25% health
15. Robots now cry out (SFX) when damaged
16. Robots now lament (SFX) when losing a round/match

notes.title: Update 20250313 - GDC Demo
notes.notes:
We've put in a LOT of time and effort over the last few weeks to have a proper build to demo for friends at GDC in San Francisco this year.

Key Features:

 Core Gameplay works great
 Player Vs AIBot works great
 3 Playable Robots (Moth, Hopper, Tusk)
 3 Battle Arenas (The Dome, The Night League, and The Lair)
 22 Abilities and Powerups
 Playable up to Level 20 with batches of abilities unlocking every 5 levels


Known Bugs:

 Robot Stats and Details in LOADOUT menu is still WIP, and may not accurately reflect various details.
 After finishing a match, Level and XP show as Level 1, 0 XP, but will correctly update after entering/exiting LOADOUT, SHOP, or SETTINGS.
 Gamepad controls and navigation are WIP but work as intended in matches.
 A few sound effects aren't triggering correctly but shouldn't affect gameplay.

Please note, we will likely update shop thresholds again in the future as we see to remove barriers from gameplay.
